conversion.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version n8.1.1-20260506 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
conversion.intermediate: 16-bit FLAC at original source rate and channels
conversion.channel_processing: Average (L+R)/2 in floating point before resampling; retain fractional samples
conversion.resampler: Sequential 512-phase 100 dB Kaiser-windowed sinc; floating-point output retained until normalization
conversion.normalization: One track-wide gain; validate final rounded 8-bit PCM sample and true peaks <= -1 dBTP including loop seam; reduce excess plus 0.1 dB and re-encode, at most five attempts
conversion.true_peak_meter: FFmpeg EBU R128; loop seam included; upper bounds include 0.0005 linear metadata rounding margin
conversion.packing: Continuous LSB-first three-bit codes; stereo alternates left/right; balanced ceil(frame_count/alignment) groups, first remainder books one group longer; final segment clipped; zero final padding
conversion.reconstruction: Independent signed-16 saturating predictors retained across segments; output clamp(floor(sample/256+0.5),-128,127); predictors reset at exact loop length
conversion.crc: CRC-8 polynomial 0x07, initial zero, cumulative per 1024 packed bytes including final short chunk
conversion.codebooks: Little-endian signed-16 deltas; eight entries per channel

tool_source.note: Original source hashes identify the imported Second Reality algorithms. The local encoder adds DLT5 compact signed-16 books, balanced segments, closed-loop retraining, beam search, floating-point mono downmix, rounded output and loop-aware peak validation; conversion.encoder_files_sha256 identifies this implementation. Offline quality experiment selected this configuration using whole-track integer squared error against authenticated fixed-reference PCM, with no channel regression.
